title: Amelia's Spanish teacher says she knows more Spanish than the teacher's own children
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Amelia's Spanish teacher says she knows more Spanish than the teacher's own children, about c. 2021-2024 at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: like her Spanish teacher is like yeah I don't know what to say she knows more Spanish than my kids

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about a girl named Amelia, who appears in The Telepathy Tapes, a documentary project by Ky Dickens about children said to be able to read minds. Michels says that Amelia's Spanish teacher at her school in the American Midwest remarked that she knows more Spanish than the teacher's own children, which he tells as a sign that she picks up knowledge in ways nobody can explain.
